verdict.rationale: Groq is a hosted inference service. The only readable source in the evidence is its client SDK in a public GitHub repo (groq/groq-typescript), and nothing shows the core inference platform's source is available. The hosted open-weight models are third-party, not Groq's own source. Missing for 10: any evidence of the license on the SDK repo, public source for the core API/inference platform, and independent confirmation of open licensing.
